name: git-blame
author: lumine-code
description: Show the commit that last changed each line in a gutter.
backgroundTips: You can see who last changed each line, and when, with {{ 'git-blame:toggle' | keystroke }}

columnWidth.title: Column Width
columnWidth.description: Width of the blame gutter in pixels. Dragging the gutter's right edge changes this too.

dateFormat.title: Date Format
dateFormat.description: How each commit's date is written.

authorName.title: Author Name
authorName.description: How much of the author's name is shown.

showHash.title: Show Commit Hash
showHash.description: Show the abbreviated commit hash beside each line.

colorCommitAuthors.title: Colour Commit Authors
colorCommitAuthors.description: Mark each line with a stripe whose colour is derived from the author's name.

ignoreWhitespace.title: Ignore Whitespace Changes
ignoreWhitespace.description: Attribute a line to the commit that last changed its content, looking past commits that only reindented it.

commitUrlTemplate.title: Commit URL Template
commitUrlTemplate.description: Link template for hosts other than GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket, which are recognised already. Use `{host}`, `{project}`, `{repo}` and `{revision}`, for example `https://git.example.com/{project}/{repo}/commit/{revision}`. A repository's own `git-blame.commitUrlTemplate` git config value overrides this.
